title: Purair® DUCTED Basic Fume Hood

meta_description: The Purair DUCTED Basic Fume Hood is an exterior-venting exhaust hood designed to protect personnel from exposure to hazardous agents and toxic chemicals in various applications.
meta_keywords: purair, ducted fume hood, basic fume hood, hazardous agents, toxic chemicals, exterior-venting, exhaust hood
short_description: Air Science® Purair® DUCTED Basic Fume Hoods are exterior-venting exhaust hoods designed to protect personnel from exposure to hazardous agents and toxic chemicals in various applications.
full_description: Purair Ducted Basic Fume Hoods are ideal for applications that generate high volumes of volatile organic compounds and toxic chemicals, gases, or powders on the work surface. As a ducted fume hood, the Purair Ducted Basic utilizes an external ducting system. The air intake face velocity can be adjusted to provide the desired balance between conditioned room air conservation and the necessary volume of exhausted contaminated air.
seo_content: The Purair DUCTED Basic Fume Hood features a chemical-resistant epoxy coated steel frame and 360 degree visibility, providing comprehensive protection for operators from fume hazards. With adjustable air intake face velocity, the Purair Ducted Basic can be optimized for efficient containment and room air conservation in a variety of laboratory, industrial, and educational settings.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. This product may assist you with compliance or as part of your chemical hygiene plan. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
